THE EDINBURGH FILES

CASE NO. 004
THE TOM & JERRY CHRONICLES
📍 Location: The Streets of Edinburgh, Scotland
🔒 Classification: Top Secret (Well, not really a secret between these two 😂)

Before the investigation begins, meet the detective assigned to this very serious matter.

Special Consultant · Official Profile
🕵️‍♂️

DETECTIVE SPARSH SHARMA

SPECIAL INVESTIGATOR · EDINBURGH DIVISION

Known for: Sharp investigations, a jawline worth discussing, and a walk that has somehow caught the attention of an unofficial critic. 💀

Detective's profile:

  • Special skill: Solving cases while Shruti's friend keeps going, “Bhai, kya jawline hai! Kya walk hai!” 😂
  • Investigation style: Notices every little detail. Meanwhile, someone has been studying his pictures a little too carefully. 😭
  • Weakness: Unwanted fame. Especially when Gaurav starts reviewing his jawline and walk without ever having met him. 💀

Detective's note: “I solve mysteries for a living. I didn't know my jawline and walking style were part of the investigation.” 😂

Somewhere on the streets of Edinburgh, two suspects have been spotted arguing again. The reason remains unknown. Neither suspect is willing to cooperate with the investigation.

Case briefing: This investigation may involve excessive attitude, suspicious levels of gossip, and one very specific vegetable.

Evidence 01 · Case Record

📁 THE SILENT TREATMENT

Incident report: One argument. Two stubborn people. Zero messages.

One suspect decides to fix things. The other decides to provide the full cold-treatment experience.

Hours pass. Sometimes days.

And somehow, this investigation always ends up right back where it started.

Finding: Both are stubborn. One comes back first; the other doesn't make it easy. 💀

Case status: Repeated offence. No lessons learned.

Evidence 02 · Restricted Information

🗣️ THE CHUGLI DEPARTMENT

SECRET? NOT BETWEEN THESE TWO. 💀

Evidence collected:

  • One tells a story. The other needs every single detail.
  • “Kisi ko mat batana” is treated as a suggestion, not a rule. 😂
  • Both remember other people's business better than their own important work.
  • A five-minute conversation somehow becomes a full investigation, complete with background history, motives and unnecessary analysis.

Finding: Both suspects are excellent listeners when the topic is someone else's business. 💀

Official recommendation: Keep both suspects away from secrets. Especially when they're together. 😂

Evidence 03 · Unusual Discovery

🥬 THE BHINDI INCIDENT

Subject: Kachra, a.k.a. Doabh ki Rani

Investigators have discovered that the suspect has a special relationship with bhindi.

But the real mystery isn't how much bhindi she eats.

It's how a vegetable with such a simple personality ended up inspiring someone with this much attitude. 💀

New theory: The attitude isn't hers. It's a side effect of eating too much bhindi.

Status: Scientific evidence unavailable. Attitude levels remain dangerously high. 😂

Final Review · Detective's Decision

🎤 THE FINAL VERDICT

Case: The Tom & Jerry Files — Edinburgh Division

📍 Location: The Streets of Edinburgh, Scotland

Evidence collected:

  • Both are convinced they're right.
  • Both have enough attitude to last a lifetime.
  • Neither likes losing an argument.
  • One usually comes back to fix things.
  • The other makes sure it isn't going to be that easy. 💀

🔎 DETECTIVE'S VERDICT

“One Tom. One Jerry. Double the drama. And somehow, neither can get rid of the other.” 😂

🏰

FINAL CASE NOTE

They can go days without talking, argue over the smallest things, and annoy each other like it's a full-time job. But when they finally talk again, somehow, it doesn't feel like anything has changed. The same conversations, the same nonsense, the same old bond.

Maybe that's the thing about Tom and Jerry. They can chase each other around all day, but their story is never really over. ❤️

Investigation status: Ongoing.
Friendship status: Still going strong.
Probability of another argument: Extremely high. 💀

For Shruti · From Gaurav ❤️

Bahut din ho gaye tere liye kuch kiya nahi, aur tujhe bhi apni tareef sune hue bahut din ho gaye honge. 😂💛

Pata hai, teri ek baat mujhe genuinely achhi lagti hai. Tu apni chhoti-chhoti baatein bina filter ke share karti hai, apne mann ki baat bolti hai, care karti hai, trust karti hai aur jab gussa hoti hai, toh tere se zyada khatarnak cold treatment koi nahi de sakta. 😂 Tere saath baat karte waqt aisa nahi lagta ki har baat soch-samajh kar bolni hai. Kabhi serious baatein, kabhi faltu ki bakchodi, aur beech-beech mein tera phone par padhte rehna—tu maane ya na maane, par yeh sach hai. Hahahaha! 😂 Yeh sab teri personality ka woh part hai jo teri friendship ko special banata hai. Shayad tujhe khud realize nahi hota, par main in chhoti-chhoti cheezon ko genuinely value karta hoon. ❤️

Aur Shruti, main tujhe hamesha ek baat bolta hoon aur aage bhi bolunga: teri worth is baat se decide nahi hoti ki kaun tujhse pyaar karta hai aur kaun nahi. Tu apne aap mein ek achhi insaan hai. Teri kindness, tera nature aur teri personality ki apni value hai. Kisi ek insaan ka tujhe choose karna ya na karna kabhi yeh decide nahi kar sakta ki tu kitni achhi hai. Life mein un logon ko importance dena jo tujhe importance dete hain, aur kisi ek situation ki wajah se apni khushi mat bhool jaana.

Life mein kuch cheezein humari expectations ke according nahi hoti. Kuch baatein hurt karti hain aur unse aage badhne mein time lagta hai, lekin past ko hamesha pakad ke rakhna bhi zaroori nahi. Jo ho gaya, use accept karke aage badhna aur khud ko dobara khush rehne ka mauka dena bhi important hai. Past humari story ka ek part hai, poori story nahi. Tere aage abhi bahut kuch achha hona baaki hai. 💛

Mujhe pata hai ki hum zyada mile nahi hain aur main bhi tujhse door hoon. Main har baar tere paas aakar tera mood theek nahi kar sakta ya tere liye chhote-chhote surprises plan nahi kar sakta, jaise usually ek BF karta hai. 😂 Lekin iska matlab yeh nahi ki teri problems ya teri khushi mere liye matter nahi karti. Main har baar shayad sahi words mein nahi bata pata, par genuinely chahta hoon ki tu khush rahe aur life mein achha kare. Aur jitna mujhse ek dost ke taur par ho sakega, main utna zaroor karunga.

Aur ek baat clear kar doon, kachra. 😂 Main tere liye website banaun, koi message likhun, email bheju ya kuch aisa karun, toh uska matlab yeh nahi ki main tujhse kuch expect kar raha hoon ya tujhe kisi cheez ke liye obligated feel karwana chahta hoon. Main yeh sab isliye karta hoon kyunki tu meri achhi dost hai, aur mere liye yeh friendship ka bare minimum hai. Har friendship ko kisi aur meaning mein lena zaroori nahi hota. Mere liye teri friendship apni jagah special hai, bas. mujhe pata ha agr yehi sab tera ex ya bf nhi kiya hota tho tu bhut khush hoti par kyuki yeh maine kiya h tho tu mujhe kabhi compliment nhi kregi iss effort ka liya as usual hahaha,

Mujhe nahi pata future mein hum kitne close rahenge, life humein kahan le jaayegi ya humari situations kaisi hongi. Yeh bhi nahi pata ki hum aage kitne dost reh paayenge. Lekin kabhi bhi tu mere baare mein soche, toh bas itna yaad rakhna ki teri life mein ek dost tha jo genuinely teri friendship ko value karta tha, teri care karta tha aur dil se chahta tha ki tu khush rahe. Mere liye achhi friendship ka matlab sirf roz baat karna nahi, balki kisi ke liye genuinely achha chahna bhi hai.

hamesha lagta h ki agr m aur time ek sath ek city m hota tho jyada achi bonding aur memories bana pata  but I'm genuinely glad ki tu meri life ka part hai, Shruti. Main chahta hoon ki tu khud ko importance de, apne aap par bharosa rakhe aur life ki achhi cheezon ko enjoy karna na bhoole. Tu genuinely achhi insaan hai, aur I hope tujhe life mein bahut saari khushiyan milen. ❤️

Aur haan, ek chhoti si request hai, madam. 😂 Mujhe pata hai teri speciality mujhe roast karna hai aur meri tareef karne mein tujhe shayad allergy hai. Lekin kabhi-kabhi Gaurav ko bhi ek-do compliments de diya kar. 😭😂 Aakhir aisa dost baar-baar thodi milta hai! Har baar apni tareef khud hi karta rahun, toh phir teri friendship ka fayda kya? 💀😂

Jokes apart, Shruti, I genuinely hope ki humari bonding aage bhi aisi hi rahe. Life mein aage kya hoga, hum kitne close rahenge ya situations kaisi hongi, yeh toh nahi pata. Bas itna chahta hoon ki meri wajah se tujhe kabhi yeh feel na ho ki teri friendship ko value nahi kiya gaya. Tu genuinely bahut achhi insaan hai, aur main tujhe yeh baat baar-baar bolne mein kabhi nahi thakunga—even if tu har baar meri baat maanne se mana kar de. 😂❤️

Apna dhyan rakhna, khush rehna aur hamesha aisi hi rehna—apni unfiltered baaton, apne attitude aur apni uss bekaar si personality ke saath. 😌😂💛
